aboutGame.title: What Is Vindictus: Defying Fate?
paragraphs: Vindictus: Defying Fate is Nexon's character-driven action RPG and a modern reimagining of the original Vindictus MMO. It is built on weighty, animation-locked melee combat: every swing commits you to a recovery window, stamina pays for dodges and guards, and bosses telegraph attacks you are expected to read rather than absorb. Steam lists it as an Action RPG with Souls-like and Hack and Slash tags, headed to PC with a planned 2027 release window.

The alpha roster covers four heroes: Lann with twin swords, Fiona with a longsword and shield, Karok with a massive pillar, and Delia with a bastard sword. You can swap between them at any campfire, change your follower's hero the same way, and grow through a per-character skill tree plus a shared general tree. Battles scale from a solo campaign to online co-op Special Missions, and this wiki tracks all of it with character breakdowns, combat fundamentals, boss strategies, PC specs, and release news.

modules.name: Vindictus Defying Fate Characters
modules.description: Introduce the playable heroes Lann, Fiona, Karok, and Delia, highlighting their weapons, combat styles, core skills, and the strengths that decide which fighter suits your playstyle.

highlights.label: Lann
highlights.detail: Twin swords and fast, flashy combos built around Cross Assault, Windmill, and Fatal Fury.

highlights.label: Fiona
highlights.detail: Longsword and shield bruiser who blocks, absorbs, and punishes with Shield Bash and Focal Point.

highlights.label: Karok
highlights.detail: Half-giant with a massive pillar who trades speed for reach, stagger, and area control.

highlights.label: Delia
highlights.detail: Bastard sword specialist whose deliberate strings include Bloom Waltz and White Rose.

modules.name: Vindictus Defying Fate Beginner Guide
modules.description: Walk through your first sessions step by step: choosing a hero, reading enemy tells, timing dodges, managing stamina, swapping characters at campfires, and exploring for Ability Points.

highlights.detail: Pick a hero at the campfire: Lann for speed, Fiona for defense, Karok for stagger, Delia for technical strings.
Learn the dodge-counter rhythm before chasing damage, because a perfect dodge opens every real punish window.
Watch the stamina bar: dodging, guarding, and sprinting draw from the same pool that keeps you alive.
Swap your hero and your follower at any campfire to test weapons without restarting your run.
Open chests for Ability Points and materials, then invest in the shared general tree so nothing is wasted.

modules.name: Vindictus Defying Fate Combat Guide
modules.description: Explain the action combat system, including perfect dodges, powerful counters, heavy-hitting strikes, stamina discipline, enemy pattern recognition, and the command inputs that differ per hero.

highlights.label: Dodge
highlights.detail: Time the evade so the attack whiffs completely, because a clean perfect dodge creates the opening for everything else.

highlights.label: Counter
highlights.detail: Convert a successful dodge into immediate burst damage while the enemy is still stuck in recovery frames.

highlights.label: Heavy Hit
highlights.detail: Spend your opening on the biggest, slowest strike instead of a fast poke, then reposition and bait again.

highlights.label: Stamina
highlights.detail: Dodging, guarding, and sprinting share one pool, and an empty bar is how most wipes start.

modules.name: Vindictus Defying Fate Boss Guide
modules.description: Cover every boss documented so far, with enemy attack patterns, dodge and guard timing, solo versus co-op tactics, and a repeatable game plan for surviving difficult battles.

highlights.label: Chief
highlights.detail: Gnoll Chieftain Crimsongale opens the campaign with wide sweeping swings that catch late dodges.

highlights.label: Shadowfang
highlights.detail: Fast, relentless pressure with short recovery windows and lunging closes, so punish only after the last hit.

highlights.label: Sharptooth
highlights.detail: Aggressive beast-type brawler whose charges carry generous hitboxes, so sidestep instead of backpedaling.

highlights.label: Snowskin
highlights.detail: A cold-climate endurance fight with slow, heavy area attacks that punish greedy combos.

modules.name: Vindictus Defying Fate Tier List
modules.description: Compare the four alpha heroes by combat style, damage potential, survivability, mobility, and ease of use so you can pick a main that matches how you like to fight.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Fiona: longsword and shield with block, absorb, and counter-punish tools, the most forgiving first main.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Lann: twin-sword speed and combo chaining with the highest execution ceiling in the roster.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Delia: bastard-sword strings that reward learning full sequences rather than mashing.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Karok: massive pillar, slow but wide, built for stagger and crowd control over mobility.

items.question: What is Vindictus: Defying Fate?
items.answer: Vindictus: Defying Fate is Nexon's character-driven action RPG and a modern reimagining of the original Vindictus. It is built around animation-locked melee combat where every swing carries a commitment cost, stamina fuels your dodges and guards, and bosses telegraph attacks you are meant to read and counter.

items.question: When does Vindictus: Defying Fate come out?
items.answer: Vindictus: Defying Fate is listed for a 2027 release window on Steam, with no exact day announced yet. The store page is live and wishlisting is open, which is where a confirmed date appears first.

items.question: Which characters can I play in Vindictus: Defying Fate?
items.answer: The alpha roster covers four heroes: Lann with twin swords, Fiona with a longsword and shield, Karok with a massive pillar, and Delia with a bastard sword. You can swap between them, and change your follower's hero, at any campfire.

items.question: How does combat work in Vindictus: Defying Fate?
items.answer: Vindictus: Defying Fate combat follows a five-beat loop: bait an attack, land a perfect dodge, convert it into a counter, spend the opening on a heavy strike, then reset. Stamina pays for dodging, guarding, and sprinting, so managing that single pool decides most fights.

items.question: Can my PC run Vindictus: Defying Fate?
items.answer: The published minimum is Windows 10 64-bit with an Intel Core i5-9400F or AMD Ryzen 7 1800X and a GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) or Radeon RX 480 (8 GB). The recommended tier asks for a Core i7-10700K or Ryzen 7 3700X with an RTX 3060 or RX 5700 XT.

items.question: Does Vindictus: Defying Fate have co-op?
items.answer: Yes. Vindictus: Defying Fate pairs a solo campaign with online co-op, and boss encounters split between campaign fights and cooperative Special Missions. The Steam listing recommends playing with a controller.
